name: Wabi-Sabi
what_it_means: Wabi-Sabi is a Japanese philosophy that finds beauty in the imperfect, impermanent and incomplete. In UI it means earthy neutrals, natural textures (paper, clay, stone), asymmetric layouts, irregular organic shapes, generous emptiness and a calm, contemplative pace.
signature_moves: Muted earthy neutrals, paper and clay textures
Quiet serif or mincho type, vertical text
best_for: Ceramics, tea houses, architecture, skincare, mindful products
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a homepage for [CERAMICS / TEA / MINDFUL BRAND] in a Wabi-Sabi style. Warm rice-paper background (#EEE9E0) with subtle paper fibre texture. Asymmetric layout with lots of empty space. A single photo of a hand-made, imperfect ceramic bowl inside an irregular organic shape (uneven border-radius). Earthy neutrals (#C8BFB0, #8B7E6A, #4A4238) and one muted rust accent (#A65E3A) like a hanko seal stamp. Typography: a quiet serif / mincho (Shippori Mincho), small sizes, a short vertical Japanese line. Thin hand-drawn brush stroke divider. Slow fade transitions only.
